caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #85: CIRCUMLOCUTION

circumlocution (noun): using many words to avoid saying something directly.

✅ In a sentence: The spokesperson's circumlocution never actually answered the question.
✅ Similar: evasion, wordiness, roundabout talk
✅ Remember it: circum- (around) + locution (speech): talking around it.
